pages.title: Arrow Go
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Arrow Go challenges you to empty a board of arrows without blocking their exits. Each arrow can travel only in the direction it points. Find the ones with a clear route first, then use the openings they leave to release the rest.

pages.title: Zipzap
pages.creator: GhostRiderr
pages.description: Zip Zap is a number-connecting puzzle in which your route begins at 1 and continues in order. Follow the sequence across each board and work toward a quicker completion time. Choose a difficulty or try the daily challenge for a fresh arrangement.

pages.title: Goodeluxe
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Goodeluxe turns groups of matching Goo into points. Click clusters containing at least two pieces and watch the poison count when you select an isolated one. Six poison points end the run, while the absence of a timer gives you room to plan.

pages.title: Savage Defenders
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Savage Defenders puts a tribal village under threat from alien invaders. Arrange your defense around warriors and magical powers to stop the attackers reaching their objective. Decide how to use the tribe's forces as the invasion builds around the volcano.

pages.title: Puppy Treat Sorting
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Puppy Treat Sorting is a matching puzzle built around dog bones and limited holding slots. Tap bones to send them into the tray and bring matching treats together. Choose the order carefully so unfinished combinations do not fill the available space.

pages.title: Slime Farm!
pages.creator: Qam Games
pages.description: Slime Farm sends a suction truck out to gather slimes. Vacuum them up, sell the collection and put the earnings into improvements. Increasing the truck's capabilities lets you continue collecting and develop more of the farm.

pages.title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Dazzling Divas Makeup lets you create pony-inspired looks for Lila, Mimi and Roxy. Explore cosmetics influenced by Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie and Rainbow Dash, then coordinate tops and accessories. Give each diva a look that reflects her chosen inspiration.

pages.title: Cat Escape - Hide and Seek
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Cat Escape Hide and Seek follows a little cat sneaking through household spaces. Use furniture and hiding places to stay outside the guards' view while solving the route ahead. Collect coins along the way and unlock different appearances for your escape artist.

pages.title: Boat Mania
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Boat Mania is a sorting puzzle about getting colored cars onto the appropriate boats. Move boats into loading positions and match them with the waiting traffic. Consider the available docking space before each selection so the queue can continue moving.

pages.title: Doge's Battle Royale
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Doges Battle Royale puts an armed Doge into a fight for survival. Move through the battlefield, attack opponents and collect useful items left behind. Keep track of nearby threats while trying to outlast the other fighters.

pages.title: Home Design - Match 3
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Home Design Match 3 combines matching puzzles with room decoration. Make matches to complete the board's objectives and use boosters when an arrangement becomes difficult. The rewards from those puzzles help you continue furnishing and personalizing the home.

pages.title: Agent Zero: Infiltration
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Agent Zero Infiltration is a stealth challenge built around moving through guarded security areas. Guide the agent past surveillance and choose a safe moment to advance. Watch how the threats cover the route before committing to the next movement.

pages.title: Wild West Match 2: The Gold Rush
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Wild West Match 2 fills its puzzle boards with frontier-themed pieces such as hats and horseshoes. Make matches of three to work through the level objectives. Use dynamite when obstacles interfere with your plans and uncover what lies beneath the board's barriers.

pages.title: Hex Planet Idle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Hex Planet Idle follows a stickman warrior gathering resources across a world of hexagonal areas. Approach materials to collect them and check the marked requirements for opening new ground. Spend what you gather to keep expanding the accessible planet.

pages.title: V And N Pizza Cooking Game
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: V And N Pizza lets you prepare a pizza from its early cooking steps through to the finished dish. Work with the ingredients, add your chosen toppings and bake the result. Follow the kitchen activities to put the meal together.

pages.title: Free the Ball
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Free Ball asks you to slide blocks into positions that create a route for a ball. Study the gaps and rearrange the pieces until the destination becomes reachable. Each board presents another path-building problem to solve.

pages.title: Grimelda Fun House
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Grimelda Fun House follows a large purple zombie through a platform adventure. Collect shakes, avoid obstacles and keep moving through the house's challenges. Upgrades and collectible cards provide more ways to develop Grimelda and unlock different looks.

pages.title: Pond Story
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Pond Story sends you on an adventure to save a friend. Explore the surroundings, fight enemies and gather gold to buy equipment. Switch weapons when needed and use what you have collected to prepare for the next part of the journey.

pages.title: Zen Sort Parking Puzzle
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Zen Sort Parking asks you to organize cars by color within a limited parking area. Select a car and move it to an available position that accepts its color. Think through the order of transfers so mixed groups do not trap the remaining vehicles.

pages.title: Ninja Up!
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Ninja Up sends a ninja upward using jumping lines you draw beneath him. Place each line to control the next launch and keep the climb going. Adjust your drawing to the height you need rather than repeating the same jump.

pages.title: Lawn Mower Puzzle
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Lawn Mower Puzzle turns a patch of grass into a route-planning problem. Choose horizontal or vertical movements to take the mower through the lawn and cut the remaining sections. Look for a route that covers the whole area without leaving an awkward patch behind.

pages.title: Transport Wavy Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Transport Wavy Jigsaw offers transport pictures with two approaches to assembling the pieces. Choose a conventional jigsaw or try the wavy-piece version, then reconnect the parts into a complete image. Use the picture's shapes and details to guide each placement.

pages.title: Tank MIX
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description: Tank MIX combines tank merging with battles against alien attackers. Bring together tanks of the same level to create a stronger vehicle, then let your armored force fight. Use the results of combat to keep improving the lineup.

pages.title: Hangman Plus
pages.creator: K17 Games
pages.description: Hangman Plus challenges you to uncover a hidden word by choosing letters. Work through its campaign or select a category for a different set of words. Use the revealed letters to narrow the possibilities before the drawing reaches its final stage.

pages.title: Cat Chef and Broccoli
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cat Chef and Broccoli follows a broccoli character trying to reach the refrigerator before a pursuing cat catches up. Jump over kitchen hazards and keep clear of hostile cookies. Use the double jump to handle obstacles along the escape route.

pages.title: Number Jumping
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Number Jumping puts a green box on platforms marked with numbers. Landing on a tile reduces its number by one, and reaching zero removes it. Plan the sequence of jumps so you can clear the numbered arrangement without losing the route you still need.

pages.title: Red Stickman: Fighting Stick
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Red Stickman Fighting Stick combines platform exploration with enemy combat. Move the red hero through dangerous stages, jump past hazards and fight the creatures blocking the way. Collect gems as you progress and prepare for stronger enemies farther into the adventure.

pages.title: Thief Quest
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Thief Quest is a stealth escape game about slipping past security. Watch the guarded areas, choose a route and move when an opening appears. Collect available items and outfits while trying to make it out without being caught.

pages.title: Candy Escape
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Candy Escape uses rotation to move its character through a hazardous level. Turn the screen so gravity carries you along the route, collect coins and reach the flag. Check where the spikes will be before changing the level's orientation.

pages.title: Tangled Gardens
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Tangled Gardens asks you to plan water connections for thirsty plants. Study the available routes and arrange a line that delivers water where it is needed. Consider how the path uses the garden's space before completing the connection.

pages.title: Fighting Stars Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fighting Stars Memory hides matching character pictures behind cards. Turn over pairs, remember their locations and clear the arrangement before time expires. Progress through the levels by reducing the number of searches needed to find each match.

pages.title: Royal Heroes
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Royal Heroes gives you an army to build in a kingdom threatened by dark magic. Recruit heroes, strengthen your force and send it into battles against hostile creatures. Put the money earned from victories toward the troops needed for later encounters.

pages.title: Christmas Tiles
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Christmas Tiles asks you to remove adjacent groups of at least three matching tiles. Work through the seasonal board while considering the pieces each removal leaves behind. Use a snowflake to destroy a troublesome tile when normal matches no longer provide a way forward.

pages.title: Squid Challenge Escape
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Squid Challenge Escape turns the familiar contest setting into an action escape. Move through the facility and fight the enemies standing between your character and freedom. Stay mobile while dealing with attacks and look for a route out of each dangerous area.

pages.title: Beach Connect Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Beach Connect Mahjong is a timed tile-linking puzzle with a seaside theme. Connect two identical pictures using a clear path that turns no more than twice. Clear accessible pairs to create new routes and finish the board before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Paint the Game
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Paint Game presents pictures with a missing detail for you to draw. Examine what is already on the page and sketch the part that makes the image complete. Use the lightbulb hint when the absent object is difficult to identify.

pages.title: Pole Dance Battle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pole Dance Battle asks you to adjust a dancer's position to match openings ahead. Drag to change the pose as each wall approaches, then line up the body to pass through. Timing the adjustment matters as much as choosing the right shape.

pages.title: Pokey Ball Jumper
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Pokey Ball Jumper sends a ball up a wall toward treasure. Stretch and release it to climb, then tap to pin it in place for another launch. Watch for hard wall sections where the needle cannot attach and time your throws around the obstacles.

pages.title: Water Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Water Sort Puzzle gives you containers of mixed colored liquids to separate. Pour between them to collect each color together, respecting which colors can receive the next layer. Leave useful empty space so an early transfer does not block the rest of the solution.

pages.title: Donut Slam Dunk
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Donut Slam Dunk is a timing game about dropping a swinging donut into a box. Watch the rope's movement and release at the right moment. Judge the donut's position before letting it fall toward the opening below.

pages.title: Mosquito Smash Game
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Mosquito Smash asks you to tap mosquitoes before they reach people. Keep scanning the play area as new insects appear and work toward the level's required total. Quick, accurate selections help prevent the growing swarm from getting past you.

pages.title: Magnificent Tower
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Magnificent Tower challenges you to place office floors into a rising stack. Time each placement to keep building and increase your score. Power-ups such as insurance and repeat give you additional ways to manage the next section of the tower.

pages.title: Bubble Cave
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bubble Cave drops colored bubbles toward a cluster inside a cave. Rotate the center to bring matching colors together and form groups of three. Use special bubbles when helpful and keep the growing arrangement from reaching the cave's edge.

pages.title: Stickman Fighting 3D
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Stickman Fighting 3D lets you choose a character for a physics-based brawl. Move into position and combine attacks to deal with the opposing fighter. Control the spacing between you and the enemy so your strikes land without leaving an easy opening.

pages.title: Trump Flying Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Trump Flying Adventure is a cartoon flying challenge featuring a parody of Donald Trump. Tap to keep the character airborne and try to extend the flight. Judge the rhythm of your inputs while dealing with the route ahead.

pages.title: FPS Shooting Strike : Modern Combat War 2k20
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: FPS Shooting Strike Modern Combat War 2020 puts you in first-person combat against hostile forces. Move through the battlefield with the keyboard and aim your weapon with the mouse. Find a useful firing position while watching for enemies who can return fire.

pages.title: Johnny Trigger 3D Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Johnny Trigger 3D Online challenges you to hit enemies with carefully timed gunfire. Wait for a clear shot and aim accurately instead of wasting ammunition. Each encounter asks you to deal with its targets using the bullets available.

pages.title: Cartoon Escape Prison
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Cartoon Escape Prison is a route-drawing escape puzzle. Draw paths for the prisoners while keeping their movement away from patrolling guards. Check how the routes cross the prison before sending anyone into a dangerous area.

pages.title: PIZZA DELIVERY BOY SIMULATION GAME
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Pizza Delivery Boy Simulation gives you a motorbike and a job delivering pizzas. Ride through the delivery setting and bring each order to its destination. Keep control of the bike while following the route required for the next customer.

pages.title: Buche De Noel
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Buche De Noel walks you through preparing a French log-shaped dessert. Follow the cooking activities and work with the ingredients to create the cake for a birthday celebration. Complete each kitchen step before moving on to the finished dessert.

pages.title: Choli Jet
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Choli Jet follows a character flying with a modest jetpack. Use short bursts to control the flight and avoid obstacles along the route. Balance climbing with falling so the next hazard does not catch you at the wrong height.

pages.title: Space Pong
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Space Pong puts paddle-and-ball play into ten space-themed stages. Move left and right with the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons to meet the moving ball. Adjust your position as the different obstacle arrangements change its path.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Doctor Play
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Doctor Play turns an injured teddy bear into the patient for a pretend clinic. Help Hazel use her toy medical set and follow the play activities. Attend to the bear as the little doctor works through its make-believe treatment.

pages.title: Trucks Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Trucks Slide lets you rebuild truck pictures by moving their scrambled parts. Choose one of the three images and a puzzle mode, then work out the order of moves. Use the vehicle's details to recognize where each section belongs.

pages.title: Angry Flying Zombie
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Angry Flying Zombie is a catapult game in which stones are your weapon against zombies. Aim each launch and send the projectile toward its target. Adjust your next shot according to where the previous stone landed.

pages.title: Prison Escape
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Prison Escape puts you inside a guarded prison with freedom as the objective. Explore the route, avoid security and use movement options such as running and crouching to get through dangerous areas. Handle hostile encounters while looking for a way out.

pages.title: Cute Animals Sky Fall
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Cute Animals Sky Fall sends an animal falling through a sky filled with hazards. Steer away from rocks and airplanes while collecting stars. Watch the space below the character so your next movement leaves room to dodge.

pages.title: Couple Lovers Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Couple Lovers Puzzle offers six anime-style couple pictures as jigsaws. Select an image and choose a piece count ranging from 16 to 100. Reassemble the scene by matching the characters, colors and background details across the scattered pieces.

pages.title: Cake Shop
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Cake Shop puts you in charge of preparing cakes for customers. Check each request and make the cake that matches the order. Keep track of what is waiting so you can continue serving the people who visit the shop.

pages.title: Clash Blade IO
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Clash Blade IO pits sword-carrying fighters against each other while orbs help them grow. A higher level gives you a larger blade but slows your movement. Choose timed ranked battles for coin and experience rewards, or play the separate endless mode.

pages.title: Crossy Bridge Blocky Cars
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Crossy Bridge Blocky Cars asks you to complete crossings by placing moving bridge sections. Watch a section approach the gap, then click when it lines up with the road. Correct placement gives the blocky car a route across.

pages.title: Jack O Lantern Pizza
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Jack O Lantern Pizza gives you a Halloween-themed cooking project. Prepare a pizza and use toppings such as pepperoni and black olives to create a pumpkin face. Follow the recipe activities to turn the decorated ingredients into the finished dish.

pages.title: Zombie Fun Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Zombie Fun Jigsaw offers a set of twelve zombie-themed pictures to rebuild. Choose a puzzle with 25, 49 or 100 pieces, then fit its scattered sections together. Increase the piece count when you want a more involved assembly.

pages.title: Drift Max Inception
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drift Max Inception puts different cars and tracks at your disposal for drifting. Steer through the course, use the handbrake to help the car slide and adjust your line around corners. Switch cars or camera views to try another driving setup.

pages.title: WaterPark Slide.io
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Waterpark Slide IO sends racers down a crowded water slide. Steer around blocks, keep the course ahead in view and contest position with the other riders. Push through the field while trying to reach the finish first.

pages.title: Cursed Treasure: Level Pack!
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Cursed Treasure Level Pack asks you to protect valuable gems from invading heroes. Build defenses belonging to orcs, demons and the undead, then strengthen them as attacks continue. Place your towers to cover the routes leading toward the treasure.

pages.title: Road Garbage Dump Truck Driver
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Road Garbage Dump Truck Driver puts you on a city cleanup route. Drive the truck through the streets, collect the waiting garbage and transport the load as required. Follow the pickup locations to keep the collection work moving.

pages.title: Fish3D.io
pages.creator: juegocaca.com
pages.description: Fish3D.io is a fish survival game with swimming, faster movement and attacks. Search the environment for resources and food while keeping away from fish that can kill you. Use the movement and action controls to manage encounters with other creatures.

pages.title: Russian Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Russian Trucks Jigsaw lets you assemble twelve pictures of Russian trucks. Choose a 25-, 49- or 100-piece arrangement and connect the scattered sections. Look for matching vehicle details and background edges to rebuild the image.

pages.title: Hop Hop
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Hop Hop challenges you to move a ball through circles while gathering mushrooms. Time the hops to line up the next passage and keep the run going. Judge the approaching circle before making another jump.

pages.title: Shark Attack
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Shark Attack puts you in the water as a shark trying to grow. Eat smaller sharks and keep an eye on the creatures around you as the feeding continues. Build up your shark while working toward a higher place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Kid's Jump
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Kids Jump is a platform-jumping challenge with colorful graffiti scenery. Keep the character landing safely as brick piles build higher. Watch the next platform and time the jump so the growing stack does not end the run.

pages.title: Football multiplayer
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Football Multiplayer brings a football match to online opponents or friends. Drag your player to position and kick the ball, then react to the other side's movement. Create an opening toward goal while defending your own end.

pages.title: EG Speed Racer
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Speed Racer challenges you to keep a car moving without crashing. Watch the route ahead and adjust the vehicle's position to avoid danger. Maintain control for as long as possible while trying to improve the run.

pages.title: Raccoon Rescue
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Raccoon Rescue is a bubble-shooting puzzle about freeing trapped young raccoons. Aim colored shots into the bubble arrangement and bring matching colors together to clear a route. Work toward each stage's rescue target while choosing where the next bubble will land.

pages.title: PinataMasters Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Pinata Masters Online turns pinatas into targets for a growing collection of weapons. Shoot them to earn coins, then spend those earnings on stronger equipment. Continue through the stages with upgrades that help you deal with the next pinata.

pages.title: Bubble Match 3
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Bubble Match 3 asks you to arrange matching bubbles into groups of three. Study the colored pieces and make matches to increase your score. Look for combinations that leave another useful match available on the board.

pages.title: Free Rally Two
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Free Rally 2 is a vehicle playground with a selection that includes cars, a buggy, a police motorcycle and a helicopter. Explore the available machines and their different capabilities. Some vehicles carry rockets, while the police vehicle adds an arrest feature.

pages.title: EG Flappy Chicken
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Flappy Chicken takes the flapping flight challenge into a Thanksgiving-themed setting. Keep the chicken in the air while guiding it past obstacles. Time each input to maintain a useful height and continue farther along the route.

pages.title: Ninja Dragon
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Ninja Dragon sends you climbing between two walls while fighting enemy ninjas. Jump from side to side, slash attackers and avoid dangerous ledges. Matching hits can build a boost, while a shield offers help during the climb.

pages.title: Boxing Fighter Shadow Battle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Boxing Fighter Shadow Battle makes you defend against attacking yokai from both sides. Time punches to the left and right as the enemies close in. Follow the attack indicators and handle the changing threats before they overwhelm the fighter.

pages.title: The Last Panda
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Last Panda is a turn-based trapping puzzle on a hexagonal board. Block routes before the panda reaches the edge and escapes. Think beyond the next step so your placements close off the animal's remaining paths.

pages.title: Cake Shop: Bakery
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Cake Shop Bakery follows a traveling cake-making business serving customer requests. Prepare flavors such as chocolate, vanilla and strawberry, then decorate the cakes to suit their orders. Complete the baking work as the shop visits new locations.

pages.title: Motorbike Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Motorbike Simulator gives you a motorcycle to ride and explore. Practice controlling the bike, try stunts and see how it handles the available environment. Adjust your speed before attempting another maneuver so you can keep the ride going.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 5 Part 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Adam and Eve 5 Part 1 follows Adam through another point-and-click search for love. Examine each scene and interact with objects or characters to remove the obstacle ahead. Work out the useful sequence of actions before moving onward.

pages.title: Merge Babies
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Merge Babies asks you to combine matching youngsters as they grow toward their teenage years. Keep finding compatible pairs and manage the space they occupy. Each teenager you create adds to your score and gives you another result to build toward.

pages.title: Halloween Hidden Pumpkin
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Halloween Hidden Pumpkin challenges you to find pumpkins concealed in seasonal pictures. Scan each scene carefully and select the hidden objects before the timer expires. Search the details around the obvious shapes to locate the remaining pumpkins.

pages.title: Monkey Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Monkey Bubble Shooter asks you to help a monkey recover bananas across bubble-filled stages. Aim colored bubbles and make matching groups to clear the arrangement around the fruit. Plan shots that open useful space for the next banana rescue.

pages.title: Mahjong Pyramids
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Mahjong Pyramids puts matching tiles into layered arrangements for you to clear. Find available identical pairs and work through the stack before time expires. Use the offered assistance when the remaining layout becomes difficult to read.

pages.title: Burger Clicker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Burger Clicker turns clicks on a burger into game currency. Spend your earnings on upgrades that increase the business's income, including money generated over time. Balance clicking with purchases to keep the counter growing.

pages.title: Tropical Mahjong
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Tropical Mahjong offers sixteen summer-themed tile boards. Look for available pairs with identical pictures and remove them to expose more of the arrangement. Work through each layout by considering which matches open useful tiles underneath.

pages.title: Parking Panic
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Parking Panic asks you to free a red car from a crowded parking area. Slide the surrounding cars, buses and trailers to create a clear lane to the exit. Plan several moves ahead so one vehicle's new position does not trap another.

pages.title: My Slime Mixer
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: My Slime Mixer lets you put together a colorful slime creation. Work through the mixing activities, choose colors and add glitter for a different finish. Experiment with the available decorations to personalize the result.

pages.title: MLP Elements of Harmony
pages.creator: MDV Games
pages.description: MLP Elements of Harmony is a timed matching puzzle built around chains of identical elements. Select three matching pieces to trigger an energy chain and clear connected elements. Check the targets displayed below the board and complete them before time runs out.

pages.title: Bob The Robber 4 season 1: France
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Bob The Robber 4 France sends Bob into guarded buildings in France to collect loot. Explore rooms, deal with locks and stay clear of guards and security cameras. Use safe openings in the surveillance to reach the target and make the theft successful.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Halloween Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Halloween Makeup combines a beauty routine with a seasonal makeover. Work through the face-care activities, then choose cosmetics and face paint for the character. Put the available colors and designs together into a Halloween look.

pages.title: Red ball vs green king
pages.creator: Game-Level
pages.description: Red Ball vs Green King follows a ball on a rescue mission through rooms filled with traps. Jump through the platform challenges and find a safe route upward. Keep working through the king's dangerous surroundings to reach the kidnapped girlfriend.

pages.title: Lovers Shopping Day
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Lovers Shopping Day takes a couple to the mall for new outfits. Start with clothing choices for the girl, then dress her partner. Coordinate the available pieces to give both characters looks suited to their shopping day together.
